answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Certified gas engineer registration with gas safety register attestation. It requires a registration the register renews after assessed work, so the nectar of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The ferrous is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The sonnet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
